description: This file contains unit tests for the CuTeDSL grouped matrix multiplication (grouped_mm) functionality in PyTorch's inductor module. It tests the correctness of the grouped_mm function with various input configurations and ensures compatibility with the Cute backend.

classes.name: TestCuTeDSLGroupedGemm
classes.description: A unittest TestCase class testing grouped matrix multiplication via CuTeDSL backend with various input configurations and ensuring correctness.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor] _get_inputs( self, group_size: int, M_hint: int, K: int, N: int, device: str, dtype: torch.dtype, alignment: int = 16, )
methods.description: Generates input tensors for grouped matrix multiplication tests, including input matrices and offsets based on group size, matrix dimensions, and device specifications.

methods.name: test_grouped_gemm_basic(self, group_size: int, M_hint: int, K: int, N: int)
methods.description: Tests the basic correctness of grouped_mm function with eager execution and compiled CuTeDSL backend, comparing results for consistency.

methods.name: test_grouped_gemm_assorted_layouts( self, layout_A: str, layout_B: str, )
methods.description: Tests grouped_mm with various tensor layouts (contiguous, offset, padded, view) to ensure correct functionality across different memory arrangements.

ctags.pattern: /^from torch._inductor.test_case import run_tests, TestCase as InductorTestCase$/
